theme_stances.key_argument: Markets are adjusting to the hawkish tilt of the new Fed Chair's first meeting.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI's rapid expansion is driving strong earnings and investment beyond US tech.
theme_stances.evidence: AI’s rapid expansion is driving strong earnings and investment beyond US tech

theme_stances.key_argument: AI is a powerful structural investment opportunity with demand spreading across enterprises.
theme_stances.evidence: Demand is not only intact but spreading across enterprises

theme_stances.key_argument: Resilient US economy and fiscal support will enable the rally to extend beyond AI-linked stocks.
theme_stances.evidence: we believe that both the AI-led part of the market can drive further gains

theme_stances.key_argument: Macro and structural tailwinds support earnings growth and a broadening of market performance.
theme_stances.evidence: We maintain our Attractive view and continue to recommend well-diversified exposure

theme_stances.key_argument: Asia's industrial IT supply chain is the backbone of the global AI buildout and will benefit from hyperscaler spending.
theme_stances.evidence: Asia's supply chain has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the global AI buildout.

theme_stances.key_argument: The bull market drivers—economic growth, profit growth, Fed support, and AI adoption—remain intact.
theme_stances.evidence: we believe the bull market drivers remain intact

theme_stances.key_argument: AI data center growth will drive significant electric power demand and capital spending for utilities.
theme_stances.evidence: significant growth in AI data centers to drive a strong increase in electric power demand

theme_stances.key_argument: AI-linked stocks will continue to support the market as demand visibility and earnings momentum remain strong.
theme_stances.evidence: We continue to view it as a powerful structural investment opportunity.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI demand remains resilient, supported by rising GPU prices and strong cloud revenue growth.
A powerful global investment cycle in AI, technology, defence, and infrastructure continues to drive growth.
theme_stances.evidence: Our Investment Outlook Update conveys a continued positive view of equities.

theme_stances.key_argument: US-centric allocations are accelerating, reinforcing the US as the principal driver of DM strength.
theme_stances.evidence: US dominated allocations with $3.2B of net inflows, up roughly 30% week-on-week

theme_stances.key_argument: Valuations returned to less extreme levels following last week's correction, and AI infrastructure investment remains strong.
theme_stances.evidence: prompted us to adopt a positive view on equity indices once again

theme_stances.key_argument: Buying the supply chain is the most direct way to capture AI benefits before diffusion occurs.
theme_stances.evidence: the best way to play any AI bullishness is simply to buy the AI supply chain.

theme_stances.key_argument: Competition from Chinese models is forcing hyperscalers to accelerate spending to maintain the frontier gap.
theme_stances.evidence: the natural response during an arms race is not to be outspent by your rival

theme_stances.key_argument: AI capex spend in 2027 will be extremely strong, supporting EPS momentum for infrastructure winners.
theme_stances.evidence: it is unequivocally clear that AI capex spend in 2027 will be extremely strong

theme_stances.key_argument: Investors are questioning if AI will commoditize application-layer products, causing a transfer of value to infrastructure landlords.
theme_stances.evidence: The question investors may be starting to ask is whether we are witnessing the early stages

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI trade is entering a dangerous final phase driven by excessive leverage and debt-funded capex.
theme_stances.evidence: history suggests the final phase of a mania is often the most profitable and the most dangerous
